result.stdout:
dotnet-ai - CodingWithEase AI Capability Providers host
Usage: dotnet-ai <command> [arguments] [options]

Commands:
  init                             Discover capabilities (recursively across all bin/ folders)
                                   and generate .dotnet-ai.json & AGENTS.NuGet.md.
                                   Providers live in BUILD OUTPUT: run 'dotnet build' first.
  list                             List all discovered capabilities from the manifest
  inspect <Package>                Display detailed metadata for a package
  execute <Capability> [json|-]    Execute a capability. Args: inline JSON, '-' for stdin,
                                   or --args-file. Returns structured JSON.
  mcp                              Serve the manifest's capabilities as MCP tools over stdio
                                   (for MCP-native agents; run 'init' first)

Options:
  -p, --path <path>                Target directory or project file (default: current directory)
  --args-file <path>               Read execute arguments from a JSON file (avoids shell escaping)
  --package <name>                 Disambiguate when two packages expose the same capability name
  --raw                            execute: print only the generated output (pipe/redirect friendly)
  --json                           list/inspect: print machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help                       Show help information

Typical agent workflow:
  1. dotnet build                        (providers are discovered from build output)
  2. dotnet-ai init                      (once per solution, and after rebuilds that change providers)
  3. dotnet-ai list --json               (see what is available)
  4. dotnet-ai execute CreateGrid --args-file args.json --raw > Grid.razor
